inlines.v: SE'QUENCE, noun [L. sequens, sequor.] 1. A following, or that which follows; aconsequent. 2. Order of succession. How art thou king But by fair sequence and succession? Shak. 3. Series; arrangement; method. 4. In music, a regular alternate succession of similar chords.
